segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Welcome everyone. Let's discuss the next phase of the project. We need to finalize our tech stack and timeline.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: I propose we use React for the frontend and Python with FastAPI for the backend. It aligns with our team's expertise.

segments.speaker: UI
segments.text: React works great for us. We can design components reusably.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Great, so we've decided on React and Python. Development starts next week. Dev, can you setup the development environment?

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: Sure, I'll have it ready by Friday. I'll also document the setup process.

segments.speaker: QA
segments.text: We should define testing strategy early. I recommend automated tests for backend and end-to-end tests for frontend.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Good point. Let's aim for 80% code coverage. QA, please document the testing plan by next Wednesday.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: We'll need to deploy to Cloud Run. I suggest using Docker for containerization.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Perfect. Let's use Google Cloud infrastructure. Dev, please setup CI/CD pipelines by Sept 1st.

segments.speaker: UI
segments.text: When do we need the design mockups? I can start creating them this week.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Please share mockups by next Friday so dev can start implementation.

segments.speaker: QA
segments.text: We should also plan for user acceptance testing. Can we schedule a demo in 2 weeks?

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Yes, let's schedule UAT for September 5th. Everyone should be prepared to present their work.
